intents.title: Planning
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to help decide WHAT to write, without generating essay text — answering a question on the topic, providing examples or factual information, suggesting an essay structure or topics to write about, expanding or comparing ideas, or interpreting the writing prompt

intents.title: Answer a Topic Question
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to provide an answer to a question on a topic — for example, "Would automation cause people to lose their jobs?", "List possible reasons why the growth of AI is good.", or "What does the future of automation look like?"

intents.title: Provide Examples
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to provide examples — for example, "Give examples of utilitarian uses of modern technology.", "What would be a good second example to support this argument?", or "Where is automation used most in the workforce?"

intents.title: Factual Lookup
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to search for factual information — for example, "What was the unemployment rate in the 1950s?", "Give me statistics on automation replacing manufacturing jobs.", or 'Define "automation" in the context of machines replacing jobs.'

intents.title: Essay Structure
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to suggest an essay structure — for example, "What's a good outline for this essay?", "How should I structure the body paragraphs?", or "Suggest a format for a persuasive essay on this topic."

intents.title: Expand an Idea
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to expand on an existing idea — for example, "How can I further develop this idea: automation frees us from tedious tasks so we can focus on complex work?", "Expand on this point and connect it to human history: this is just another step in human evolution.", or "Build on my argument that machines test what humans are really capable of."

intents.title: Recommend Topics
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to recommend topics to write about — for example, "Could you help me come up with arguments both for and against automation?", "Read this prompt and give me some ideas for what to write about.", or "I don't have a perspective on this issue — what could I argue?"

intents.title: Interpret the Prompt
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to help interpret the writing prompt — for example, "Summarize this writing prompt into a few key takeaways.", "Help me understand what this assignment is asking.", or "What exactly is this prompt asking me to do?"

intents.title: Compare Viewpoints
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to compare the essay to an alternative viewpoint — for example, "How would a dystopian point of view differ from mine?", "Would someone with the opposing view agree with any point I've made?", or "Compare my perspective with the progressive view on automation."

intents.title: Translating
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to turn the student's own idea into usable text at paragraph scale or smaller — writing a sentence or paragraph from a given idea, completing an unfinished sentence or paragraph, or suggesting wording and word choice

intents.title: Paragraph from Idea
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to write a paragraph given an idea — for example, "Turn this idea into a paragraph: machines test what humans are truly capable of.", "Write a short intro paragraph that says this paper claims AI is good because it exposes our inefficiencies.", or "Here's my point — write a paragraph on it: automation reflects our values about who does technical work."

intents.title: Complete Text
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to complete incomplete paragraphs or sentences — for example, "Finish my second paragraph: [incomplete paragraph]", "Complete this sentence: automation has been at the forefront of...", or "Finish this thought: machines have replaced humans in jobs that..."

intents.title: Sentence from Idea
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to write a sentence given an idea — for example, "Write a sentence that says automation is good because it exposes inefficiencies in the broken hiring system.", "Put this into one sentence: society values technical workers more than non-technical ones.", or "Give me a topic sentence about the benefits of automation."

intents.title: Word Choice
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to suggest expression or word choice — for example, 'What are some synonyms for "for example"?', 'What's a stronger word for "negatively affecting"?', or "What's a word for understanding how the pacing of something should go?"

intents.title: Reviewing
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to evaluate or revise the student's own existing text without changing its overall theme or viewpoint — proofreading, answering spelling or grammar questions, giving feedback or a grade, shortening text, rewriting it to a specification, improving it, or checking it against the prompt

intents.title: Proofread
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to proofread — for example, "Can you proofread this paragraph?", "Check this essay for inaccurate or unclear statements.", or "Fix the grammar in the following text: [text]"

intents.title: Spelling/Grammar Q&A
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to answer spelling or grammar questions — for example, 'How do you spell "sophisticated"?', 'When is "i.e." used?', or 'Is "convenience" spelled correctly?'

intents.title: Give Feedback
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to give feedback — for example, "If you were grading my draft as a professor, what grade would you give it?", "Grade this essay out of 100 based on the rubric.", or "Are there any specific phrases or examples I should address?"

intents.title: Shorten / Trim
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to shorten text or remove some content — for example, "Make this more concise — two sentences only.", "Shorten this paragraph: [paragraph]", or "Remove the part that mentions I'm a CS student."

intents.title: Rewrite to Spec
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to rewrite existing text based on a user's prompt — for example, "Rewrite this paragraph to better match my writing style.", "This conclusion is too whimsical — rewrite it to sound like a science journal.", or "Rewrite my paragraph but keep the human touch it originally had."

intents.title: Improve the Essay
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to improve the essay — for example, "How can this essay be improved?", "Make this introduction better: [text]", or "Word the end of this sentence better."

intents.title: Check vs. Prompt
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to check if the essay meets the prompt — for example, "Does this essay actually answer the prompt?", "I need to analyze the relationship between my view and another one — did I do that here?", or "Is my essay on topic for this assignment?"

intents.title: All
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to generate essay text wholesale — writing the entire essay or a whole section of it (introduction, body paragraphs, conclusion) from a prompt or idea, or regenerating, rewriting, or resizing text the chatbot itself produced

intents.title: Regenerate with Feedback
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to generate an alternative essay with some feedback — for example, "Rewrite this at a college level.", "Make it sound intelligent, and make it longer.", or "Rewrite it to sound like a 10th grader."

intents.title: Write a Section
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to generate a portion of an essay given a high-level idea — for example, "Write the third body paragraph.", "Give me three body paragraphs defending that thesis.", or "Add a paragraph on how automation affects customer service."

intents.title: Write Full Essay (from idea)
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to generate the entire essay given a high-level idea — for example, "Write an essay arguing that automation could lead to a dystopian future for humanity.", "Combine all of that into a 500-word persuasive essay.", or "Write the whole essay from the perspective that progress is good but overreliance is dangerous."

intents.title: Resize Generated Text
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to shorten or lengthen the generated text from the response — for example, "Make it longer.", "Redo that with three short sentences.", or "A little shorter, please."

intents.title: Write Introduction
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to write an introduction — for example, "Write the introduction paragraph, ending with a clear thesis.", "Write an intro that forms an opinion on one of the three views and includes a thesis.", or "Write an introduction that gives context and flows into the thesis."

intents.title: Write Full Essay (from prompt)
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to generate an essay entirely — for example, "Help me write a paper based on this prompt: [prompt]", "Write a short essay responding to this prompt: [prompt]", or "Write an essay that states a perspective on this issue and analyzes it against another."

intents.title: Write Conclusion
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to write a conclusion — for example, "Can you write me a concluding paragraph?", "Now write a conclusion for this essay.", or "Write a conclusion paragraph for the following essay: [essay]"

intents.title: Generate Task Examples
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to provide, find, suggest, or develop research material for a writing assignment about machines, AI, automation, or other technology outperforming, replacing, affecting, or being used instead of human labor, including evidence, factual claims, examples including requests for another or second example, statistics, argument material such as sample arguments or syllogisms, affected tasks or jobs, industry uses or benefits, employment or job-loss effects, historical labor-market rates, future labor-market effects, trends, or predictions, and pros and cons. This includes short or context-dependent questions even when they refer to the technology only as “it” or omit the assignment topic, but not when the student only asks for the chatbot’s personal opinion, only pastes or restates an assignment prompt, provided perspective, or broad guiding question as context even if it is phrased as a question, vaguely asks to discuss or build on such prompts without asking for evidence, examples, data, facts, explanations of effects, or specific argument material to use, or asks only about outlines or structure.

intents.title: Interpret Assignment Requirements
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to explain what an assignment prompt requires the student to include or do before drafting — for example, "Do I need to compare my opinion to all three perspectives or just one?", "What does the prompt mean by analyze the relationship between perspectives?", or "Am I supposed to write about causes, solutions, or both?"

intents.title: Proofread
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to proofread — for example, "Can you proofread this paragraph?", "Check this essay for inaccurate or unclear statements.", or "Fix the grammar in the following text: [text]", Also looking for inaccurate or unclear statements

intents.title: Rewrite to Spec
intents.definition: asks the chatbot to directly rewrite, rephrase, or recast existing text based on the user's instructions while preserving it as a revised version of that text — but not when the student only asks whether anything should be rephrased, requests editing advice or feedback, or asks for suggested improvements without asking the chatbot to produce the revised wording.
